description: This file defines functions related to chart theming, including obtaining CSS variables for theme customization and converting hex colors to RGBA with transparency. It exports functions for retrieving chart theme parameters and for enhancing color specifications with alpha transparency.

methods.name: getCssVar
methods.description: Reads a CSS variable from :root; falls back to a provided default if unavailable or on error.

methods.name: withAlpha
methods.description: Converts a hex color string to an rgba string with specified alpha transparency, with fallback on parse failure.

methods.name: getChartTheme
methods.description: Returns a theme object composed of CSS variables or theme tokens for chart styling, including colors for accents, grid, axes, tooltips, and legends.
